_comment: SVI-LoRA variant of wan22_i2v_distill_4step.json (VERIFICATION run). Adds lora_configs pointing at SVI v2.0-pro high/low LoRAs (Stable Video Infinity, subject/identity continuity). LightX2V Wan22MoeDistillRunner.load_transformer statically merges high LoRA into the high-noise expert and low LoRA into the low-noise expert (build_wan_model_with_lora, non-lazy path — no lora_dynamic_apply needed). SVI keys are QWEN-format (blocks.N....lora_A/B.default.weight), which LoRALoader supports; watch the 'Applied N LoRA weight adjustments' log to confirm key hit-rate. NOTE: SVI was trained for the 40-step CFG base model; stacking on the 4-step CFG-free distill is what this run measures.
